_note: Experiment 5 freeze. Every fixture in "files" was authored BEFORE src/manyu/underdetermination.py existed - at freeze time there was no criterion, no seeder and no derivation, only the Stage -1 substrate tests. Experiment 3 section 5 named the absence of this as one of the things standing between it and "done"; experiment 4 wrote it and this reuses its verifier rather than duplicating one.
_enforcement: Fixtures are enforced continuously by salience.verify_fixture_freeze(path, experiment="5") - a fixture edit invalidates results. The pre-registration is hashed here for the same reason: choosing a threshold after seeing a distribution is experiment 1 failure mode #1, and this is what makes "the numbers were fixed in advance" checkable rather than remembered. Amending is allowed and is recorded in pre-registration section 8; amending silently is not.
_commit_note: Files were untracked at freeze time; the hashes here are the authority, not the commit.

pre_registration._note: Written 2026-08-11, after Stage -1 and before any mechanism. Section 0 records a measurement rather than a prediction and says so.

_standards_note: Populated when the criterion tests are written. Enforced by the runner before a scored run, deliberately not by the test suite - adding a check strengthens the standard and must stay cheap; weakening one after a result is visible is the actual risk.

mechanisms._mechanism_note: Recorded at the end of the offline stages. Stage 5 is a scored run against a live provider, so this is the value a Stage 5 pre-flight must re-check: a criterion edit between here and there invalidates the offline results the live stage is compared against.
